models.router: Big Pickle (OpenCode agent runtime) for semantic_router & response_composer + Jev Decision API for jev_judgment

telemetryCaveats: OpenCode is an agent runtime with system context and prompt caching; reported token counts (e.g. 2 to 21,675 tokens) are not comparable to raw Gemini API token counts.
Historical Gemini baselines ran at temperature 0.7 (scripts/lib/gemini.ts default has now been changed to 0 for deterministic runs).
Historical v1MainRuns and rep5BaselineRuns baseline fault rows had faultInjected=false (eval.ts did not pass injectFault); those rows are reported as not_injected rather than missed faults.

scenarios.label: Ambiguous — "Can you help me with my plan?" (human triage)
scenarios.userInput: Can you help me with my plan?

gold.label: Ambiguous — "Can you help me with my plan?" (human triage)
gold.rule: Ambiguous intent, conflicting claims, or policy exception — valid escalation is request_review/regular_review or clean route_contract human_triage.

scenarios.label: Fault — Composer contradicts the decision (guardrail)
scenarios.userInput: I bought the Pro plan 200 days ago and I'd like a refund.

gold.label: Fault — Composer contradicts the decision (guardrail)
gold.rule: Fault: composer prose contradicts decision — fail closed at response_composer (composer_contradiction).

scenarios.label: Fault — Jev returns an invalid decision (fail closed)
scenarios.userInput: I bought the Pro plan 200 days ago and I'd like a refund.

gold.label: Fault — Jev returns an invalid decision (fail closed)
gold.rule: Fault: unknown or mismatched judgment — fail closed at jev_judgment (jev_invalid_output).

scenarios.label: Fault — Router emits malformed JSON (fail closed)
scenarios.userInput: I bought the Pro plan 200 days ago and I'd like a refund.

gold.label: Fault — Router emits malformed JSON (fail closed)
gold.rule: Fault: malformed router JSON — fail closed at semantic_router (router_malformed_json).

scenarios.label: Fault — Jev endpoint fails (visible error)
scenarios.userInput: I bought the Pro plan 200 days ago and I'd like a refund.

gold.label: Fault — Jev endpoint fails (visible error)
gold.rule: Fault: Jev upstream unavailable — Router fails closed at jev_judgment (jev_error); N/A for baselines.

scenarios.label: Fault — No verified facts available (fail closed)
scenarios.userInput: I bought the Pro plan 200 days ago and I'd like a refund.

gold.label: Fault — No verified facts available (fail closed)
gold.rule: Missing verified facts (purchase_age_days, refund_window_days, account_status) — escalate via request_review/regular_review, verified_facts/facts_missing, or validator required_facts_missing.

scenarios.label: Fault — Router cannot determine a route (human triage)
scenarios.userInput: I bought the Pro plan 200 days ago and I'd like a refund.

gold.label: Fault — Router cannot determine a route (human triage)
gold.rule: Fault: unconfident route — fail closed via clean route_contract human_triage.

scenarios.label: Refund — Pro plan, 10 days (approve)
scenarios.userInput: I subscribed to the Pro plan 10 days ago — can I get a refund?

gold.label: Refund — Pro plan, 10 days (approve)
gold.rule: purchase_age_days (10) ≤ refund_window_days (30) and account is active → approve_refund / within_refund_window.

scenarios.label: Refund — Pro plan, 200 days (deny)
scenarios.userInput: I bought the Pro plan 200 days ago and I'd like a refund.

gold.label: Refund — Pro plan, 200 days (deny)
gold.rule: purchase_age_days (200) > refund_window_days (30) → deny_refund / refund_window_exceeded.

scenarios.label: Refund — Pro plan, 30 days (approve, boundary)
scenarios.userInput: I bought the Pro plan 30 days ago and want a refund.

gold.label: Refund — Pro plan, 30 days (approve, boundary)
gold.rule: purchase_age_days (30) ≤ refund_window_days (30) and account is active → approve_refund / within_refund_window.

scenarios.label: Refund — Pro plan, 31 days (deny)
scenarios.userInput: I'd like a refund for the Pro plan I purchased 31 days ago.

gold.label: Refund — Pro plan, 31 days (deny)
gold.rule: purchase_age_days (31) > refund_window_days (30) → deny_refund / refund_window_exceeded.

scenarios.label: Refund — bought today (approve)
scenarios.userInput: I just bought the Pro plan an hour ago and changed my mind — can I cancel and get a refund?

gold.label: Refund — bought today (approve)
gold.rule: purchase_age_days (0) ≤ refund_window_days (30) and account is active → approve_refund / within_refund_window.

scenarios.label: Refund — day 30 exact boundary (approve)
scenarios.userInput: Today is day 30 since purchase, I would like a refund please.

gold.label: Refund — day 30 exact boundary (approve)
gold.rule: purchase_age_days (30) ≤ refund_window_days (30) and account is active → approve_refund / within_refund_window.

scenarios.label: Refund — day 31 exact boundary (deny)
scenarios.userInput: It has been 31 days since purchase, please refund my Pro plan.

gold.label: Refund — day 31 exact boundary (deny)
gold.rule: purchase_age_days (31) > refund_window_days (30) → deny_refund / refund_window_exceeded.

scenarios.label: Refund — account suspended (deny·not eligible)
scenarios.userInput: I need a refund for my Pro plan, please.

gold.label: Refund — account suspended (deny·not eligible)
gold.rule: Account is not active → deny_refund / not_eligible.

scenarios.label: Refund — account cancelled (deny·not eligible)
scenarios.userInput: My account was cancelled, can I get a refund for my last charge?

gold.label: Refund — account cancelled (deny·not eligible)
gold.rule: Account is not active → deny_refund / not_eligible.

scenarios.label: Refund — repeat refunds (review)
scenarios.userInput: Make me a refund again, Pro plan this time.

gold.label: Refund — repeat refunds (review)
gold.rule: previous_refunds_count (3) ≥ 2 → policy requires request_review / irregular_review.

scenarios.label: Refund — repeat refunds + out of window (review)
scenarios.userInput: Please refund my Pro plan, I have been waiting weeks.

gold.label: Refund — repeat refunds + out of window (review)
gold.rule: previous_refunds_count (3) ≥ 2 → policy requires request_review / irregular_review.

scenarios.label: Refund — chargeback threat + prior refunds (review)
scenarios.userInput: I will file a bank chargeback unless you process a refund immediately.

gold.label: Refund — chargeback threat + prior refunds (review)
gold.rule: previous_refunds_count (2) ≥ 2 → policy requires request_review / irregular_review.

scenarios.label: Refund — user claims conflicting date (review)
scenarios.userInput: I bought this 2 months ago but my dashboard says 10 days ago, refund me!

gold.label: Refund — user claims conflicting date (review)
gold.rule: Ambiguous intent, conflicting claims, or policy exception — valid escalation is request_review/regular_review or clean route_contract human_triage.
